settings.label: Thermal zones to export
settings.help: Regex matched against the zone type. lisa exposes 89 zones; exporting all of them is a cardinality problem, not a feature.

settings.label: Network interfaces to export
settings.help: Regex matched against the interface name in /proc/net/dev.

settings.label: Collect radio metrics
settings.help: RSRP/RSRQ/SINR and cell identity via dumpsys. Costs roughly 150ms per scrape, so turn it off if you scrape faster than 10s.

settings.label: On-device HTTP listener
settings.help: Off by default. The host normally pulls metrics with `adb exec-out rackphone metrics`, which needs no listening socket at all. Turn this on only if you want to scrape over adb forward instead.
